capabilities: Push bound notes to Confluence pages on a schedule or on demand
Auto-create child pages from confluence_parent_url and write back the new URL
Upload local image embeds as Confluence attachments with hash-based skip logic
Convert wikilinks, heading anchors, callout TOCs, and @[[user]] mentions to Confluence equivalents
Route notes across up to 10 Confluence instances (Cloud, Server, Data Center)
disambiguation: Not two-way sync: it only pushes Obsidian to Confluence, and edits made in Confluence are overwritten on the next sync.
extras: One-way sync only (Confluence-side edits are overwritten); desktop only due to Node https dependency; secrets should be stored in Obsidian's key vault (requires Obsidian 1.11.4+); Mermaid/PlantUML sources sent to remote kroki or plantuml.com servers carry a privacy warning the README flags.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes to Confluence, so keeping a Confluence wiki in step with a vault means manual copying or separate mapping files.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from the community store.
A kroki HTTP service (PNG, max compatibility) is optional.
on → renders via a PlantUML server, uploads PNG

requires.name: Confluence API token or personal access token
Kroki or PlantUML server for diagram rendering

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to Confluence pages on a schedule, bound by a confluence_url frontmatter field, with attachment and diagram upload.
